title: Patch: the shop, pack and collection screens speak the reader's language — translated refusals and card names
thread:
**Issue #2053 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2053: Patch: the shop, pack and collection screens speak the reader's language — translated refusals and card names Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means A reader playing in Chinese still hits English on the screens where they spend currency and manage their collection: server refusal messages on the shop, pack-opening and token pages render raw English ("that card is not yours" stays English even though the dictionary translates it), and card names on collection buttons, cosmetic labels and pickers render English while the card face beside them is drawn in Chinese. After this patch those surfaces speak the reader's language like the rest of the client. ## Why Two gaps, one fix pattern. First: `wordsOf` (`apps/web/src/shop/Shop.tsx:31-33`) returns raw `cause.message`, rendered untranslated at `Shop.tsx:121,202`, `TokenPicker.tsx:103,130`, `CosmeticPacks.tsx:174,286`, `PackOpening.tsx:339,485` and `collection/TokenOffer.tsx:127` — while the convention wraps server sentences in `t()` (`auth/AccountError.tsx:67`, `game/Game.tsx:697`, `duos/CoopPanel.tsx:66`, `Marketplace.tsx:68`), the dictionary already holds the keys (`zh-CN.json:183` translates "that card is not yours"), and `t()` identity-falls back on unknown strings so wrapping is strictly non-regressive. Second: `def.name`/raw catalog names render at `OwnedCards.tsx:68` (aria-label), `CardCosmeticsView.tsx:112,308,319`, `CosmeticsPanel.tsx:27`, `TokenPicker.tsx:179`, `CosmeticPacks.tsx:58-59` and `cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx:147` — while `readerName`/`chineseName` is the convention everywhere else (`PoolGrid.tsx:159`, `DeckSidebar.tsx:138`, `PatchNotes.tsx:69`), which R711000 covers "in the collection alike". ## Proposal Wrap the refusal renders in `t()`; render card names through `readerName(def)` (or `chineseName(id, name, def)` where only an id and name are held), matching the neighbouring convention. Any new client literal gains its `zh-CN.json` entry, which `i18n.test.ts` enforces. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/shop/`, `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, `apps/web/src/collection/`, `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Every listed error render goes through `t()` - [ ] Every listed card-name render goes through `readerName`/`chineseName`, aria-labels included - [ ] New client literals have dictionary entries; engine and server sentences keep their `{name}`-template fallback - [ ] English rendering is unchanged ## Size and risks Small: mechanical wrapping at about a dozen sites plus dictionary entries. No behaviour change for English readers; the only risk is a missed site, which a pass over `{error}`/`{loadError}` renders in the same directories closes. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40506500010)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal A reader of Chinese gets their own language on the shop, pack-opening, token and Collection screens: (1) every refusal or failed-read message rendered there goes through `t()`, (2) every card name rendered there goes through `readerName` (aria-labels included), (3) no new client literal is added, so `zh-CN.json` stays unchanged and server sentences without an entry still fall back to English, and (4) English renders exactly as before. This applies R711000 ("in a match and in the collection alike"). It adds no ruling. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.tsx` | change | `{t(loadError)}`, `{t(error)}`; header comment | | `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx` | change | `{t(loadError)}`, `{t(error)}`, `readerName(card)`; import; header comment | | `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx` | change | `{t(loadError)}`, `{t(error)}`; private `cardName` replaced by `cardNameOf`; header comment | | `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx` | change | `PackScene` `{t(error)}`, panel `{t(loadError)}` | | `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx` | change | `{t(error)}` | | `apps/web/src/collection/collection.ts` | change | new exported `cardNameOf` | | `apps/web/src/collection/CosmeticsPanel.tsx` | change | `cardNameOf(cardId)`; drop the `CATALOG` import | | `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx` | change | tile `aria-label` via `readerName` | | `apps/web/src/collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx` | change | dialog `aria-label` and `

` via `readerName` | | `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx` | change | dialog `aria-label` via `readerName` | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | the shop contract's "verbatim" (line 349) | | `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` | change | `#2053` tests, locale reset | | `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx` | change | `#2053` tests, locale reset | | `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.test.tsx` | change | `#2053` tests, locale reset | | `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.test.tsx` | change | `#2053` test, locale reset | | `apps/web/src/collection/collection.test.tsx` | change | `#2053` tests, locale reset | Do not touch: `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` (no new literal), anything under `spec/`, `crates/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`, or any `package.json` or config. **Do not change `CardCosmeticsView.tsx:112`** (``). That name seeds the art's motif under R503, which is English on purpose; `CardFace` passes `face.englishName ?? face.name` for the same reason. Governing: R711000 (`spec/rulings/R711000.md`), CLAUDE.md rule 7. Read `apps/web/README.md` (the shop paragraph, about lines 335–352, and the i18n paragraph at about line 709) first. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/shop/Shop.tsx`** - In the JSX, change `{loadError}` (inside `data-testid={shopTestid.loadError}`, about line 121) to `{t(loadError)}`. - Change `{error}` (inside `data-testid={shopTestid.error}`, about line 202) to `{t(error)}`. - In the header comment at line 6, change "shows the server's words verbatim with" to "shows the server's words through `t()` (R711000) with". - Leave `wordsOf` as it is. Wrapping at render time follows a language switch. Wrapping inside `wordsOf` would freeze the language the failure arrived in. 2. **`apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx`** - Add `import { readerName } from "../cards/chinese.ts";` as the first `../` import, above `import FillBar …`. - `{loadError}` (about line 103) becomes `{t(loadError)}`. - `{error}` (about line 130) becomes `{t(error)}`. - In `TokenBody`, `{card.name}` (about line 179) becomes `{readerName(card)}`. - In the header at line 9, change "the server's words verbatim with" to "the server's words through `t()` (R711000) with". 3. **`apps/web/src/collection/collection.ts`** - Add `import { readerName } from "../cards/chinese.ts";` directly above the `../cards/cosmetics.ts` import. - Insert this between `ownedCosmetics` and `cosmeticKindWords`: ```ts /** R711000: a catalog card's name as the reader reads it (`readerName`), else its id. */ export function cardNameOf(cardId: string): string { const def = CATALOG[cardId]; return def === undefined ? cardId : readerName(def); } ``` 4. **`apps/web/src/collection/CosmeticsPanel.tsx`** - Change `card: CATALOG[cardId]?.name ?? cardId` (line 27) to `card: cardNameOf(cardId)`. - Add `cardNameOf` first in the `./collection.ts` import list. - Delete `import { CATALOG } from "@jackioh/cards";` and the blank line after it. It is unused now. 5. **`apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`** - Delete the function `cardName` (lines 57–60, with its doc comment). - Add `import { cardNameOf } from "../collection/collection.ts";` after the `EquipButton` import. - Replace both calls: `cardName(slot.grant.cardId)` (about line 240) becomes `cardNameOf(slot.grant.cardId)`, and `{cardName(cardId)}` in the chase `
